country_scale.units: treasury/debt/gdp_total in billions; GDP per capita in thousands
country_scale.warning: Historical target GDP is not spendable treasury. Calibrate actual GDP, employment, cash and debt after scenario startup.

pacing.recommendation: Small steps21–35days, substantial reforms42–49, financed major projects56–70, rare capstones84. Native cost is points, not days. MD cost7.86 approximates55days.

effect_libraries.name: Treasury changes
effect_libraries.example:
set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.005 } }
modify_treasury_effect = yes
effect_libraries.notes: Costs0.5%GDP. Updates money dirty state, but no affordability check. Never set history payment-skip flags to make a focus free.

effect_libraries.name: GDP-relative project payment
effect_libraries.notes: Sketch uses existing primitives; no Greek project helper exists yet. Future wrapper must era/tag-gate, recheck cash/ownership, persist paid project identity and block dependent outcomes while pending. A small administrative subsidy does not purchase an instant factory.

effect_libraries.name: Debt accounting
effect_libraries.notes: Adds/clamps debt and updates dirty state. Debt reduction is not income; repayment must charge matching treasury. No focus-created foreign debt forgiveness.

effect_libraries.name: Domestic borrowing
effect_libraries.notes: Existing helper checks interest_rate<20 and no cheap IMF mission.1%fee is explicitly supplied. Future wrapper verifies success before marking funding; one-time per project. This is market borrowing, not a human-country lender.

effect_libraries.name: Repay debt
effect_libraries.notes: Clamps payment to available cash and outstanding debt. It debits both cash and debt. Never reward an unfinanced focus with an arbitrary debt haircut.

effect_libraries.name: Cold War loan trap
effect_libraries.notes: Helper clamps nominal2%GDP principal to0.5–25b and adds equal debt without ordinary1%fee. At Greek12.957GDP target the0.5floor is3.86%GDP. Do not advertise as exact2% or as a foreign state grant.

effect_libraries.name: Tax rate
effect_libraries.notes: Rates clamped0–50. Minus1 means one tax-rate point, not1%relative tax revenue. Government tax stances must replace/reset policy rather than repeatedly subtract on party changes.

effect_libraries.name: Productivity

inputs.temp_productivity_change: absolute index points, not GDP or percentages

effect_libraries.notes: Direct level helper exists but affects every controlled state including occupations. Ordinary Greek reform rewards should use gradual growth modifiers, real funded infrastructure and education. Never set overall_productivity/gdp_total directly.

effect_libraries.name: Corruption
effect_libraries.notes: One guarded step per major audited milestone. At corruption_level_01 the native helper instead grants150PP. Do not call at the floor, repeatedly, or via each party branch. Avoid double counting the native corruption idea with starting penalties.

effect_libraries.name: Internal faction opinions
effect_libraries.notes: Matching faction idea must actually exist. Positive changes double for MD autocrat/junta slots including22; negative changes do not. Under the Greek junta+5 means+10. Modest base2.5–5 and real winners/losers; do not copy irrelevant foreign factions.

effect_libraries.name: Queued industrial construction
effect_libraries.notes: Finite one-time financed capstone. Charge explicit subsidy atomically before queue insertion; native construction IC/workforce still apply. Verify cap and ownership at outcome. Do not invent extra shared slots or silently substitute another reward.

effect_libraries.name: Factory helper warning
effect_libraries.notes: Arms/civilian instant helpers cost7.5b each and create extra slots. Office helper costs12b and ALSO grants a fossil plant. About58%/93%of Greek target GDP; unsuitable normal rewards. Never add a second cost or skip global payment.

effect_libraries.name: Resource improvement
effect_libraries.notes: State141 has steel11/aluminium3 in local history. Financed one-time mine improvement adds1–2 existing units, with total cap. No automatic oil discovery or new resources in every state.

effect_libraries.name: Shelters
effect_libraries.example: 141 = { add_building_construction = { type = civilian_shelter level = 1 instant_build = no } }
effect_libraries.notes: Building costs15000IC base plus15000per extra level, max10/state. Own/control/free-slot guards and finite funded pilot required. Existing Israel120day prepaid/refund pattern is a reference, not a Greek API. Shelter effects reduce nuclear casualties, not all war losses.

effect_libraries.name: Native economic projects
effect_libraries.notes: Sync helper only repairs the flag. Native20%construction project ideas run at0.001×GDP×(1+projects_cost_modifier) per weekly budget: roughly5.2%GDP/year if kept all year. Use the full existing decision lifecycle or define a separately funded Greek programme; do not grant hidden free permanent project ideas.

effect_libraries.name: Research bonus
effect_libraries.example: add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_engineering_bonus uses = 1 bonus = 0.25 category = CAT_construction }
effect_libraries.notes: Normal1use25%targeted bonus; rare capstone30–50%. No free research slots, instant modern tech or default ahead-of-time reduction. Select categories with actual1970 research available.

effect_libraries.name: Party/person gate
effect_libraries.notes: Use MD subparty indices, not just outlook. Central set_leader is already1970safe; do not call modern set_leader_GRE directly. Selecting a representative must not elect a new party. Person gates only where biography matters.

effect_libraries.name: Current-government programme
effect_libraries.example: enable = { original_tag = GRE IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } }
effect_libraries.notes: Greek modifier IDs/contribution variables still need definitions. Only the current government's economic programme enables. Completed foci remain historical; shared grants use one capped idempotent ledger. No stacking every party after switching.

effect_libraries.name: Cold War tension
effect_libraries.notes: Clamps and refreshes GUI. Use material actual escalation. An offer/request/rhetorical focus is not another human state's consent to aid, bases, intervention or war.

greek_party_gates.1: ERE in1970; ND only from4October1974. Kanellopoulos/Karamanlis are different optional representatives.
greek_party_gates.2: Centre Union; later Centre Union–New Forces. Mavros.
greek_party_gates.3: PAK before3September1974; PASOK thereafter. Andreas Papandreou.
greek_party_gates.22: Junta/military current. Papadopoulos and optional later representatives, no automatic Ioannidis coup.
greek_party_gates.23: Royalists. ConstantineII in exile; restoration requires an actual domestic constitutional decision.

starting_spirits_proposal.name: A Constitution in Suspension
starting_spirits_proposal.rationale: Suspended democratic institutions, repression and contested legitimacy; proposed balance values, not ethnic/cultural penalties.
starting_spirits_proposal.resolution: Funded managed opening, actual civilian transition or an explicitly costly coercive security model.

starting_spirits_proposal.name: Politics in the Officer Corps
starting_spirits_proposal.rationale: Loyalty competition and political interference; does not erase the actual capable armed forces.
starting_spirits_proposal.resolution: Professional command OR a loyal security apparatus; different political/fiscal consequences.

starting_spirits_proposal.name: Patronage and Fragmented Administration
starting_spirits_proposal.rationale: Fiscal leakage and uneven administration. Inspect native starting corruption first to avoid double penalties.
starting_spirits_proposal.resolution: Paid civil-service audit OR explicit patronage bargains. No corruption-floorPPfarm.

starting_spirits_proposal.name: The Uneven Economic Miracle
starting_spirits_proposal.rationale: Preserve strong catch-up growth while representing uneven technical capacity and regional access. Do not invent an economic depression.
starting_spirits_proposal.resolution: Technical institutes, regional access and distinct political economic models; replace this spirit without duplicating its positive growth baseline.

starting_spirits_proposal.name: Security Access with Conditions
starting_spirits_proposal.activation: CONDITIONAL_ONLY: actual existing cooperation/alliance obligations; no free NATO membership or new foreign consent.
starting_spirits_proposal.resolution: A real negotiated access agreement, paid independent capability or chosen withdrawal. No automatic foreign guarantees.

progression_spirits_examples.conditions: Funded training and oversight. Does not buy equipment or spawn divisions.
Audit and actual administration; one corruption step only above floor.
Replaces previous growth baseline. A later milestone can grant a targeted1use25%research bonus.
Paid logistics organization, real supply access and ports. No free shipping or foreign bases.

political_economy_programmes.name: Directed Industrialization
political_economy_programmes.choice: Civilian industrial patronage versus military procurement. Repression costs belong to the security policy; ordinary factory foci need no arbitrary penalty.

political_economy_programmes.name: Competitive Investment and Export Manufacturing
political_economy_programmes.choice: Private credit/exports versus domestic supplier protection. Credit creates actual debt/fee; no extra invented penalty needed.

political_economy_programmes.name: Technical Education and Administrative Renewal
political_economy_programmes.choice: Broad educational access and paid teachers versus lean technical institutes; both retain worthwhile benefits.

political_economy_programmes.name: Social Investment and Productive Employment
political_economy_programmes.choice: Public industrial corporations versus worker/small-business cooperatives. Recurring welfare cost is real; no arbitrary combat debuff.

political_economy_programmes.name: Planned Reconstruction and Workplace Organization
political_economy_programmes.choice: Central investment versus cooperative autonomy. Foreign machinery and credit require actual supplier acceptance/payment; no gifted Soviet alliance.

political_economy_programmes.name: Constitutional Reconstruction and Fiscal Stewardship
political_economy_programmes.choice: Royal/state reconstruction priorities versus parliamentary fiscal oversight. A portrait is not a valid restoration mandate.

budget_and_stacking_rules.active_programmes: Exactly one CURRENT governing political economy programme. Completed foci remain history; shared institutions are globally idempotent. Party switching neither mints money nor keeps all former party buffs.
budget_and_stacking_rules.construction_cap: Authored permanent generic+type-specific construction<=25%. Native paid projects/advisors/base ideas count separately in practical balance audit.
budget_and_stacking_rules.productivity_cap: Total authored baseline+shared+oneactiveparty<=0.12base-growth units, never call it12%GDP.
budget_and_stacking_rules.buildings: Indicative complete reachable route budget: up to2civilian,1military and1dockyard queued major expansions, as selective staffed/financed capstones across the whole route. Finite infrastructure/shelter queues separately consume actual IC/upkeep. No factory every few focuses.
budget_and_stacking_rules.foreign_cooperation: An offer alone grants no payment, research, territory or alliance. Only a consenting actual actor can authorize its part after current-condition/funds checks. Silence is not agreement. No Greek focus controls Ankara, Washington, London or Moscow.
budget_and_stacking_rules.negative_rewards: Use opportunity cost, fiscal commitment, meaningful faction reactions or dependence only when caused by that selected policy. Paid normal training/research/administration can be purely beneficial.

implementation_readiness.existing: Modifier keys, source benchmarks, effects and trigger names have real local matches. Regional Greek characters and1970-safe central leader interception already exist.
implementation_readiness.new_required: Greek focus/starting/progression/programme IDs, payment/pending wrappers, contribution ledgers and future foreign consent adapters remain design contracts; they are not existing APIs.

design_audit_277.snapshot_description: Initial277-focus draft before fixes reported below. Recheck after regeneration; findings are not claims about a later corrected draft.
design_audit_277.individual_magnitudes: Plausible MD-scale individual packages, provided whole-route replacement/combined caps are designed honestly. Research0.02–0.04, max-efficiency−0.02–+0.07 and naval-coordination0.04–0.06 are supported key types.

issues.problem: Draft money sketches use GRE_programme_cost = GDP rather than gdp_total. GDP is not the verified annual GDP money variable.
issues.fix: Use gdp_total, require gdp_total>0, and recheck current affordability before any payload. Otherwise a zero/unset cost can make programmes free.

issues.problem: Naval base queued in state143 lacks a province ID. Native naval_base is a province building.
issues.fix: Choose a verified owned coastal province, include province=<verified ID>, and recheck its cap. A state alone is insufficient. This also needs a game queue test.

issues.problem: available_code contains the party/leader requirement only in a comment; metadata/rules do not enforce it.
issues.fix: Expose actual check_variable ruling_party and appropriate has_country_leader conditions in the design sketch. A broad outlook is insufficient. Do not install until native gates exist.

issues.problem: Actual excludes arrays remain permanent although choice_scope says current crisis phase. After talks, later contingency or renewed armed posture can become inaccessible.
issues.fix: Move changing stance to country-scoped event/short decisions; retain focus history once. Remove permanent graph exclusions for these reactive posture pairs. A genuine long-term programme choice can remain exclusive separately.

issues.problem: cyprus_7 demands allGRE/TUR/ENG replies/nonresponses; descendants8/9 depend on it. This reintroduces an all-counterparts barrier and contradicts the existing first-real-relevant-response milestone model.
issues.fix: First substantive relevant actual actor response completes the historical badge. Other channels stay open; later current-crisis ledgers are separate. Receipt alone is not response. No actor silence may block all Greek diplomacy.

issues.problem: Political route10/11 metadata says365days, but literal reward_code uses add_ideas.
issues.fix: Use add_timed_idea with days365, still replacing/refreshing its single slot. Do not multiply by party switching.

issues.problem: A declared cap is not yet a designed distribution. Quietly clamping later funded focuses can erase their advertised marginal benefit.
issues.fix: Allocate common+onegovernment totals against national budgets before rendering values, or display exact effective marginal gains. Include starting strength, temporary programmes and removal of negative spirits.

issues.problem: Rationing promises a reduced fuel-import burden but shows only negative modifiers, no explicit oil-shock replacement/removal slot; recovery only removes oil_shock.
issues.fix: Specify a weaker replacement shock package and its exact lifecycle. Recovery must remove/replace the temporary rationing package too. The paid policy must deliver the benefit promised by its text.

design_audit_277.upper_bound_method: Per modifier independently: choose the maximum nonnegative package in each distinct replacement slot; add all shared slots and at most one current political route.365day programmes excluded except named peak. This is a design upper bound, not proof one combination maximizes all modifiers simultaneously. Start maluses may later be removed.
design_audit_277.research_reward_observation: No targeted add_tech_bonus is presently specified in the277-node draft; many paid implementation nodes only unlock later steps. A few actual25%1use engineering/signals/naval-school bonuses would better match MD reward variety than adding more permanent research speed.
design_audit_277.not_checked: No runtime installed or engine-tested; no claim that proposed adapters or clamps already exist.

design_recheck_285.supersedes: Initial277-focus numerical and gate findings for checks explicitly marked passed below. Historical audit retained for traceability.
design_recheck_285.method: Each modifier independently: maximum nonnegative contribution in each distinct replacement slot, all shared programmes plus at most one current political government.365day ideas excluded from permanent totals. Does not sum all7governments or claim one build maximizes every key simultaneously.
provisional_remaining: Energy rationing literal swap_ideas and recovery ORfull/rationed gate pending the main authors final signal.
cyprus_8/9 still depend exclusively on cyprus_7; bounded no-response fallback needs independent domestic entry instead of falsely completing the real-response milestone.
implementation_limits: No runtime generated or game engine test performed.
State ownership/control, building caps, actual treaty implementation and current crisis instance remain future adapter duties where marked as comments.
Papadopoulos and Ioannidis both use native party22: programme replacement/enable must also preserve the distinct current-leader identity, not stack both under a bare party22check.

design_recheck_287_final.status: PASS FOR DESIGN-LEVEL EFFECTS AND THE TARGETED GRAPH/GATE FIXES. Not runtime or engine approval.
design_recheck_287_final.cap_method: All common replacement slots plus at most one current political government. Each modifier maximized separately;365day programmes excluded from permanent totals. No sum of all7governments, no hidden payoff clamp. This is an independent upper bound, not a claim one combination maximizes all modifiers simultaneously.
notes: Permanent programme maxima: construction10.8%, production efficiency cap10.85%, army organization10%, air mission efficiency10.4%, research8.5%.
Naval coordination13% includes the Aegean2%programme; maximum planning14%. These are valid MD keys and have no conflicting declared national cap in this design.
Construction including existing5%start strength and0.9%temporary regional programme reaches16.7%, still below the review proposed25%effective construction envelope.
Royal route uses an actual restoration mandate instead of falsely asserting a returned king before the process is ratified. Party23 and postratification requirements remain explicit.
CYP first-response flag is an existing current-crisis flag cleared by COLDWAR_CYP_1970_begin_crisis; a persistent Greek focus badge must never be treated as fresh foreign assent.

The current Greek choices may use a historical response badge or explicit local response-window closure; actual current-crisis eligibility and all foreign outcomes still belong to the future actor-owned adapter.
remaining_implementation_requirements: Define all NEW Greek programme/partial-oil-shock/mandate/factual-outcome IDs and adapter lifecycles before runtime. Existing native primitives do not implement those contracts by themselves.
Apply actual ownership/control/province caps/workforce checks before payment and construction payload; current comments are design duties, not executable safeguards.
Respect current party AND relevant leader for Papadopoulos/Ioannidis programmes sharing native party22. Global replacement slots must keep at most one government programme.
Recheck accepted contracts, current crisis instances, civilian-harm accounting and payment success atomically. No counterpart silence creates consent, funds or war.
Play-test focus completion, queued port construction, timed-idea replacement, saves and multiplayer callbacks before calling runtime ready.
